# Temple Scroll Column 59 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 59 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**59:1** When you come into the land which the LORD your God is giving to you, you shall not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

**59:2** There shall not be found among you one who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire,

**59:3** or a diviner of divinations, or a soothsayer, or an augur, or a sorcerer,

**59:4** or a charmer of charms, or one who inquires of a spirit, or a knowing-one, or one who seeks to the dead.

**59:5** For an abomination of the LORD is everyone doing these things, and on account of these abominations the LORD your God is dispossessing them from before you.

**59:6** Whole you shall be with the LORD your God.

**59:7** For these nations which you are possessing — to soothsayers and to diviners they listen; but as for you, not thus has the LORD your God given to you.

**59:8** A prophet from your midst, from your brothers, like you, I will raise up for them; and I will place My words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him.

**59:9** And it shall be, the man who does not listen to My words which the prophet speaks in My name, I will require it from him.

**59:10** But the prophet who acts-presumptuously to speak a word in My name which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods — that prophet shall die.

**59:11** And if you say in your heart: How shall we know the word which the LORD has not spoken?

**59:12** When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the word does not come-to-pass and does not come, that is the word which the LORD has not spoken; in presumption the prophet spoke it — you shall not be-afraid of him.

**59:13** When I cut off the nations whose land I am giving to you, and you dispossess them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

**59:14** three cities you shall set apart for yourself in the midst of the land which I am giving to you to possess it.

**59:15** You shall prepare for yourself the road, and you shall divide into three the territory of your land which I give to you as an inheritance; and it shall be for every manslayer to flee there.

**59:16** And this is the matter of the manslayer who flees there and lives: whoever strikes his neighbor without knowledge, and he was not hating him from yesterday and the day-before —

**59:17** as when a man goes with his neighbor into the forest to cut wood, and his hand is swung with the axe to cut the tree, and the iron slips from the wood and finds his neighbor and he dies — he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

**59:18** Lest the redeemer of blood pursue the manslayer when his heart is hot and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him — a soul — and to him there is no judgment of death, for he was not hating him from yesterday and the day-before.

**59:19** Therefore I am commanding you, saying: Three cities you shall set apart for yourself.

**59:20** And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as He swore to your fathers, and gives to you all the land which He spoke to give to your fathers,

**59:21** when you keep all this commandment to do it which I am commanding you today, to love the LORD your God and to walk in His ways all the days — then you shall add for yourself three more cities upon these three.

---

*EMET notes: Column 59 reworks Deuteronomy 18:9-19:10. The prohibition of divination and necromancy is presented in first-person divine speech. The prophet-like-Moses passage (59:8-12) is a key messianic text. "Knowing-one" for yidde'oni preserves the Hebrew root. "Redeemer of blood" (go'el ha-dam) rendered literally. The cities of refuge section (59:13-21) transitions from the prophetic legislation.*
